text:
Mike H: FYI — noticed console quotas are attributing some multitenant requests to the wrong route tag after the route-header shim landed. Low % but spikes when prefix caching hits. :thinking:
Liz K: ugh. Is this the header name change? which header is getting lost?
Mike H: looks like older client libs send `X-Route` while new proxy emits `X-RW-RouteMeta`. Console mapping only checks `X-RW-RouteMeta`, so legacy clients fall back to tenant-level buckets.
David P: can confirm. Repro steps: curl with `X-Route: svc-abc` shows console count under `tenant.default` instead of the per-route tile.
Sasha R: this is the telemetry -> dashboard mapping mismatch I raised last week. We planned a shim in eng-platform to normalize, but SDKs ALSO started adding a header rename in the 1.6 releases.
Mike H: yeah, Python 1.6.0 and TS 2.1.0 changed the default to `route_meta_header: "X-RW-RouteMeta"` — we didn't coordinate the console mapper.
Liz K: short-term: we can make the console accept both headers. Longer-term we should prevent SDKs from flipping defaults without console/infra.
David P: agree. I can add a tolerant parser in the console: check `X-RW-RouteMeta` then fallback to `X-Route` and emit a warning in logs. That's a quick fix.
Sasha R: that helps metrics, but rollouts still risky — if we switch SDK default back, some customers will have inconsistent attribution during canaries. Need compatibility mode in SDKs.
Mike H: proposal: SDKs add an opt-in flag `route_header_compat=true` that will send both headers during a 30d grace window. Example python: ```py
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv("RW_KEY"), route_header_compat=True)
```
Liz K: sending both headers is harmless but could confuse proxies that validate header schema. Any risk?
David P: proxy accepts extra headers fine. Only thing is duplication when customers already set custom headers. We'll guard by only duplicating if the alt header is absent.
Sasha R: can we do a phased rollout? 1) console accepts both headers (hotfix), 2) SDKs release minor with compat flag, 3) enable dual-header by default behind feature flag and 5% canary, 4) monitor attribution delta and then set default on.
Mike H: sounds good. For telemetry, we should tag events with `route_header_version` so we can filter. Add `route_header_version: v1|v2` to the ingestion payload.
Liz K: requirement for eng-platform: add `route_header_version` field to ingestion schema (nullable string). That will be a small mapper change.
David P: I'll make the console change and a small migration to populate `route_header_version` when we see `X-RW-RouteMeta`. If absent but `X-Route` present, mark `v1`.
ci-bot: deploy status: console-service patch build passed (build #4821). QA needed before canary.
Sasha R: QA checklist: run synthetic traffic with mixed SDK versions, verify per-route dashboard, ensure no spike in tenant-burn.
Mike H: timeline idea — hotfix console parser today, SDK compat minor this week, canary dual-header default behind FF next week.
Liz K: +1. I'll draft a short customer note for external-facing SDK docs about the temporary compat flag and the expected timeline.
David P: logging note: emit a single warning if we see both headers in a request so ops can spot rollouts that send duplicates.
Mike H: cool. I'll open a small RFC in eng-platform and tag devex + sdk teams. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
